reason: It's not in the App Store, so I can't find any reviews, and I have no idea who made it. I'm not putting my card into some website for an app I install from the browser. On top of that I'm not a magician, and I'd probably mess it up at Friday dinner in front of the whole family.
objection: No App Store means no reviews and no idea who's behind it, so paying 99 ₪ by card on a random site feels risky. And I'm scared I'll fail in front of everyone because I have no magic background.
would_change_my_mind: Real videos of regular Israeli people with no magic background pulling off the trick, plus reviews I can trust. Trying the free tricks first and seeing that they actually work and are easy for me would help too.
